sql: with f as (   select fl.market_ticker t, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',2) game, lower(fl.side) side,     fl.price::numeric px, coalesce(fl.quantity,0)::numeric q, coalesce(fl.fee,0)::numeric fee   from fills fl join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id = fl.kalshi_order_id   where lo.strategy = 'Kmmsell10' or lo.strategy = 'Jmmsell10' and split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) = 'KXNFLTOTAL'     and fl.filled_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'), r as (   select market_ticker t, max(case when resolved_value=100 then lower(side)     when resolved_value=0 then case when lower(side)='yes' then 'no' else 'yes' end end) res   from paper_trades where status='settled' and resolved_value in (0,100)     and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXNFLTOTAL' group by 1), m as (   select f.game, f.t, (case when r.res = f.side then 100*sum(q) else 0 end - sum(px*q))/100.0 - sum(fee) pnl   from f join r on r.t = f.t group by f.game, f.t, f.side, r.res) select count(distinct game) games, count(*) markets, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) net,   count(*) filter (where pnl < 0) markets_lost from m
